cwe_content.cwe: CWE-200,Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor

candidate.Reason: The function exposes user and group information including authentication methods without proper authorization checks beyond admin status, potentially revealing sensitive information to unauthorized actors.

candidate.Code:
@api.route('/user/<int:user_id>/')
def user_detail(user_id):
    user = User.query.get_or_404(user_id)
    submit = map(lambda p: p.division,
            filter(lambda p: p.permission == PermissionType.submit,
                user.permissions))
    review = map(lambda p: p.division,
            filter(lambda p: p.permission == PermissionType.review,
                user.permissions))
    pay = map(lambda p: p.division,
            filter(lambda p: p.permission == PermissionType.pay,
                user.permissions))
    resp = {
        u'name': user.name,
        u'groups': list(user.groups),
        u'divisions': {
            u'submit': list(set(submit)),
            u'review': list(set(review)),
            u'pay': list(set(pay)),
        },
        u'admin': user.admin,
        u'requests': user.requests,
    }
    return jsonify(**resp)
candidate.Reason: Exposes detailed user information including permissions, groups, and requests without any authorization checks, allowing unauthorized access to sensitive user data.
Exposes detailed group information including member users and permissions without any authorization checks, allowing unauthorized access to sensitive group data.
